The '''Thugs of Thule''' was a group of highly educated [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that had become infamous<ref name="Inside" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts [[Anj Rujj/Legends|Anj Rujj]] visiting the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|visited]] the establishment during the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. As {{CSWECite|III|114|Rujj, Anj}} establishes Rujj frequented the Outlander Club before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]], he thus had to have frequented the location by 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] which [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="22 BBY" /> one of the group's members, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anj Rujj/Legends|Anj Rujj]], frequently visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Rujj was present in the Outlander Club at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] also [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|visited]] the establishment.<ref name="22 BBY" /> The Thugs of Thule organization's name was shared with<ref name="Inside" /> the planet [[Thule/Legends|Thule]]<ref name="TCSWE241">{{CSWECite|III|241-242|Thule}}</ref> which was located in the [[Thurra system/Legends|Thurra system]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thugs of Thule were created for the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', which was written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside" /> The Outlander Club content in the book, which includes Anj Rujj as an active member of the Thugs of Thule, was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
